tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// snye mo gter ston rgya gangs ri bas spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi chos skor tshang ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo gu ru/ bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas 'dud// de la bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin sgrub par 'dod pas rang nyid skad cig la dpal rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i brda ru sbrul brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du zhabs brgyad bgrad pa/ zhal gsum gyi g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dkar/ dbus dmar ba/ rta mgo ljang nag rta skad 'tsher zhing*/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad me yi gur gyis gang bar bsam mo// phyag drug gi g.yas dang po na rdo rje/ bar pa na kha twāṃ ga mi mgo gsum brtsegs ba dan dang bcas pa/ tha ma na ral gri'i yu ba rang la bstan pa bsnams pa'o// g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub/ bar pa na mdung thung*/ tha ma na rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing mgul gyi bum pa nas zhabs kyi long bu yan chad khro chung tshon gang ba sdang mig tu blta ba/ kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ bye phrug phyag phugs su bcug pa ltar kha bas mig che ba'i khro chung gis gtams pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o// de ltar bsgoms pa'i zhal nas/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas khro chung rnams kyi zhal nas kyang 'brug sgra bzhin ldi ri ri sgrogs pas/ chem chem 'ur 'ur g.yos pas snang srid thams cad me phung du 'bar bas 'gegs thams cad thul gyis bsregs par bsam/ ba spu nyag ma re re'i rtsa ba nas rta mgrin dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs thams cad rang srog rang gis bcad pa ltar song bas skrag dngangs rengs brgyal bar bsam/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten du'ang bsdad dbang med par rang brlag tu brlag par bsam/

mjug sdud du/ oṃ badz+ra du na bh+yoḥ trig nan dzaḥdzaḥs ma s+t+waṃ/ zhes lo grangs bzla'o// de lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdud pa'i sngags yin pas sdig che bas gsang ngo*// sngon 'gro las sbyor rgyun sngags bsnyen sngags bzhi gcig tu dril ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o// sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya zlog sa ma ya bh+yoḥ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥskabs su 'di sham bur gdags/ de ni las sbyor gyi sngags yin no// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i man ngag bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po'i gsang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs rdzogs so// ༈ /bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs bcud cig /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs gnyan po la// rnal 'byor pas ni gus pas bstod phyag 'tshal// man ngag gsang ba'i mdzod sgo zab mo'i don// bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog chen po rta mgrin sgrub par 'dod pas/ re zhig dang por sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ bar chad bsrung bar bya snyam du bsams la/ skad cig dran rdzogs su dpal rta mgrin dbu gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ zhabs brgyad bgrad pa/ dbu gsum gyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang nag rta skad 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ bar pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga tha ma na ral gri bsnams pa'o// g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub/ bar pa na mdung thung*/ tha ma na rgyu zhags bsnams pa'o// me phung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o// dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o// rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi zor ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ mi'i skra'i skud pa/ mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng ba/ glang chen gyi ko rlon/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi/ rus pa'i rgyan no// de ltar bsgoms pa'i zhal nas sngags bzlas pas/
sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer gyis yar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhing khams la phog pas

thugs ka'i hūm̐ dmar po'i rtse mor hrīḥdamar po la sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa phul bas oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas de dag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs par bsam pa 'og bzhin no/ thugs mnyes nas 'dod yon lnga dang ldan zhing bar chad sel ba dang sdig sgrib sbyangs nas yi dam gyi lha dang khyad par med par bsam mo// mar sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer phog pas mnar med pa'i sems can thams cad kyang tsha grang btso sreg thams cad zhi nas bde ba chen por lam gyis song bar bsam mo// bar chad byed pa'i dgra bgegs la phog pas mgar gyi sol mal du rdul phran babs pa'am rtswa sbur tshig pa bzhin thal ba bun bun song bar bsam mo// mgul gyi bum pa man chad nas zhabs kyi long bu yan chad du khro chung tshon gang pa mig sdang mig tu blta ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ kha bas mig che ba/ bye phrug chag phugs su bcug pa ltar/ de lta bu'i khro chung gis gtams pa zhig rig par bsam/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i zhal nas sngags bzlas pas khro chung rnams kyi zhal nas kyang sngags sgra 'brug bzhin ldi ri ri sgrog cing*/ chem chem 'ur 'ur g.yos/ ye shes lnga'i 'od zer 'phro ba nyi ma 'bum bas gsal zhing 'tsher ba tsha la bzod thabs med pa/ dgra bgegs thams cad sbrang ma mes 'tshig pa bzhin thul te tshig par bsam/ mi'i me 'bum 'gyur bas dmyal ba'i mes tsha/ dmyal ba'i me 'bum 'gyur bas sngags kyi me'i 'od zer tsha ba yin/ zhi khro rab 'byams dang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la bsdad pa'i dbang med par rnal 'byor pa'i grogs dang*/ stong dang stobs mdzad do// yang drag po'i sngags bzlas pas snang srid kyi lha 'dre sde brgyad po yang bsdad pa'i dbang med par bsam/ 'khor lo gcig dang dpe'u chung ltar byas la/ rang lhar bsgoms pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus gnod par byed pa bkug la 'khor lo la bstim/

rang gis seng ldeng gi dbyug to la sgrub pa'i sngags btag pas steng nas rdzogs pa'i tshul du byas la sngags bzlas shing 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o// sgrub pa po'i sngags kyi 'khor lo dkar po spu gri lta bu gcig mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phro zhing dkar phro phro g.yas skor du 'khor bas bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rlung gi 'khor los rang dbang med par bkug par bsam mo// sa bon gyis 'gugs pa yin gsungs/ de nas/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas sngags kyi 'khor lo spru gri lta bu gcig sol mal lam mgal me ltar g.yas g.yon skor zer ba'ang snang*/ skor du 'khor bar bsam mo// bag zan la mi'i gzugs byas la/ de'i snying gar 'khor lo bzhag la/ rta bon pa/ ra tshil/ gu gul dang gsum gyi dud pas bdug cing sngags bzlas par bya'o// sngags bzlas pa'i phrin gyis rang dbang med par bsam mo// me'i 'khor los rang dbang med par bsregs par bsam/ snang srid thams cad me phung 'bar bar bsgoms la sngags kyi las bya'o// ba spu nyag ma re'i rtsa ba nas kyang bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dpag tu med pa spros la bgegs thams cad rang srog rang gis bcad pa ltar bsad pa dang*/ dngangs pa dang*/ rengs par bsam mo// stong gsum du'ang bsdad dbang med par rang brlag par bsam mo// drag sngags bzlas pa'i rjes la sngags 'di lo grangs bzlas so// bdag la gzhan gyis byad ka byed pa'i rmi ltas byung na/ zhabs g.yas pa'i 'og tu gnod byed kyis sa bon bsam/ dgra'i rnam shes bkug la sbrul gyis dkris la zhabs kyis mnan par bsam nas sngags bzlas na phyir zlog zab mo yin gsung ngo*// oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥtrig nan dzaḥdzaḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lha srin sde brgyad dbang du 'ubs kyis 'dus pa'i sngags yin no// shin tu sdig che bas gsang ngo*// sngon du 'gro ba/

rgyun du bzlas pa/ las sbyor/ bsnyen pa'i sngags dang bzhi yang snying gcig tu dril ba 'di kho na bzhin bzlas so// oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya zlog sa ma ya bh+yoḥ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ skabs su sngags de yang sham bur gdags/ las sbyor gyi sngags yin no// phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi don mdzad pa/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung ba'i man ngag bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po'i gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub thabs yin no// khyad par du rgyal po dang pe dkar dkor 'dre 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin no// kun la yod na ngo mtshar chung*// pad+ma 'byung gnas bdag gis ni// 'gro ba'i don du gter du sbas// skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog sa ma ya gu h+ya// ༈ /bla ma rta mgrin la btud nas// de nas dbang bskur bri bar bya// dpal rta mgrin gyi dbang bskur ba la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po la maṇ+ḍal dmar po me ri ljang gu/ khyams phyogs tshon bya'o// de'i dbus su gtor ma sha chen gyis brgyan pa bzhag mchod gtor gyis bskor ro// gnyis pa ni bdag bskyed sngon du song bas gtor ma de rta mgrin du bskyed la/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam mo// ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ mchod bstod dang bzlas pa bya'o// de nas slob ma khrus byas bgegs bskrad/ gral la 'khod pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mdor bsdus nas/ lam yan lag lnga yan chad byas la/ me tog sogs phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod de/ bum dbang dang sku yi byin dbab tu gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ rta mgrin gyi dpral ba nas 'od dkar po'i sna la rta mgrin dkar po sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma'i spyi bor thim pas lus kyi nad gdon dang sdig sgrib dag

bum dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam mo// de bzhin du mchod nas gsol ba gdab/ mgrin pa nas 'od dmar po'i sna la rta mgrin dmar po byung ba mgrin par thim/ ngag gi= gsang dbang= gsung gi= yang mchod nas/ gsol ba gdab/ thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing ga'i sna la rta mgrin mthing ga byung slob ma'i snying gar thim/ yid kyi= shes rab ye shes kyi= thugs kyi= yang mchod nas/ dbang bzhi pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dbab tu gsol/ zhes pas lte ba nas 'od zer sna tshogs pa'i sna la rta mgrin sna tshogs pa byung nas slob ma'i lte bar thim pas lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs dbyer med du byin rlabs zhugs par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma rta mgrin dbyer med pa la dpa' bo dang dpa' mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba de slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag pa dang*/ nad gdon thams cad zhal du gsol nas chem chem 'ur 'ur 'dug pa dang*/ spyi bor thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas rta mgrin du dngos su blta/ gsum pa tshogs gtor 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma dbul ba rta mgrin la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin brlabs la dbul/ gcig slob dpon pad+ma la/ gcig chos skyong la/ gcig gzhi bdag la dbul/ gcig gnod byed la dbul/ skong bshags dang bstod pa bya'o// tshogs la rol/ lhag gtor gtong*/ smon lam gdab/ bsngo ba bya/ dpal rta mgrin rgyal po'i dbang bskur gyi cho ga rdzogs so// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon pad+ma/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston/ ston pa'o// oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsungs/ gtor ma ni/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams te yi ge gsum gyis byin brlabs la/

mdun du rta mgrin bskyed/ de'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu gtor ma la zug nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa bhu ñja ho/ rak+ta pi ban+to sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes lnga'am bdun gyis phul la me tog la sogs pas mchod/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gsung*// chos rje 'od dpag med mgon rdo rje chos// spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas rngams chen sprul// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang chen kun 'dus dbang gi rgyal po ste// dbang gi mdog dmar bskal pa'i mi 'dra la// dbang chen rngams brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// dbang mdzad dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje byams pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// las ngan gdug pa'i sems can sgrol mdzad pa// zhe sdang gtum khro dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar// rngams brjid 'gying ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ dge ba sems can gyi don du sngo bar bya'o// // 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rta mgrin/ o rgyan pad+ma/ dbon ston skyer sgang ba/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ chos rje byams pa dpal/ byang sems nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub chos kyi rdo rje/ zhang ston skal ldan grags pa/ yang chos rje byams pa dpal/ 'jag chen blo gros dpal bzang*/ gung ston nam mkha' rgyal po'o// ༈ /dpal rta mgrin gyi zhal gdams zab mo bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal po rang la gnod dam/ mis rbad dam/ ma chun pa byung na/ thams cad la 'dis chog go /bdag nyid yi dam du bskyed la rgyal po rang gi mdun nam/ gar gnas par 'dug pa de'i snying gar bh+rūm̐ dmar po zhig bsam/ bh+rūm̐ de las tsakra rtsibs stong dang ldan pa kha dog dmar po zhig bsams la/

des kho'i srog rtsa la 'khor bas nyal nyal bcad par bsam zhing*/ sngags bzla ba ni/ rtsa sngags gsham la 'di gdags so// rā dza sa ma ya kiṃ ka ra pra ma shag ka ru ra/ tsakra gnod byed mā ra ya sod sod/ srog snying rbad rbad/ snying sa ma ya phye/ srog phye/ zhes bzlas so// skabs su 'di la brgya re gdags/ ma ma dgra snying la rbad rbad gzer/ kha pu mā ra ya sod/ de drag tu ngu ba dang*/ phyag byed pa dang*/ na ba byung na 'phro bcad/ bdag gis 'dis mdze yang gsos so// sri'u yang 'dis gsos so// rgyal po'i lha 'dre la 'di med kha med do// 'di nyams su longs shig 'di su la'ang bzla ma myong ngo*// lag len byas pas yid ches so// ting nge 'dzin dang sngags kyis gcun pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rta mgrin zhabs btud nas// zhal gyi gdams pa bri bar bya// rang rta mgrin du bskyed/ 'khor lo 'og ma dril la/ tri las zer ba'ang snang*/ de gnod byed rgyal por bskyed la dgug gzhug drag po bya/ rta mgrin gyi 'khor lo dril la de hrīḥlas rta mgrin du bskyed/ smyag seng ldeng gi dbyug pa zer ba'ang yod/ shad kyi dbyug pa la btags nas brdungs pas gnod byed thal ba bun bun song bar bsam/ de ltar byas pas dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags/ rmi lam du rang la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gus pas 'dud pa dang*/ gang bcol nyan pa la sogs pa 'byung*/ thul ba'i rtags la/ lha khang gog po zhig pa dang*/ lder bzo 'gyel ba dang*/ khyi dang*/ byi la dang spre'u la sogs pas cho 'phrul gang ston pa bsad pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar byung ba dang*/ gnod byed kyi 'khor lo rta mgrin gyi 'khor los gtums la khyi'am byi ba'i thod par gzhug klad khung la chas bkag tshon skud kyis rgya gram du bcings pa lha khang them pa'i 'og gam lam rgya gram du mnan la bskal pa'i mthar yang mi mthar bar bsam/ srung ba'i bya lugs ni/ 'khor lo'i sbyor ba sngar bzhin byas la/

gnod byed kyi 'khor lo rta mgrin gyi 'khor los gtums la/ rta mgrin gyi lte bar gnod byed thams cad bsdus te thar sa med par bsams la srung ba gdags so// srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// 'khor lo ma grub na/ sngon du byams pa dang snying rje bsgom/ srung mdud dril la hrīḥlas zer ba'ang yod/ rta mgrin du bskyed/ de ltar gnod byed thams cad bsdus la thar pa'i skabs med par bsams la gdags so// sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyi zhal nas/ lha sa dkar chung du dkor bdag 'khrugs nas mi mang po smyo ba la/ 'dis btul bas thams cad gsos/ lo gsum du kho dang 'gras pas/ rmi lam du sangs rgyas skyer sgang pa byon nas gdams pa 'di gnang bas/ de phyin chad rgyal po'i gnod pa tshar chod gsungs/ rta mgrin gyi gdams pa sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung bzhin a'i seṅges yi ger bkod pa'o// // ༈ /bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// grub chen skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub 'di la yid ches pa lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyis na grub chen rin po che de nyid ni skyer sgang na don gnyis mthar phyin par bzhugs pa'i skabs su rta lo dgun zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi tho rangs mnal lam bzung nas o rgyan du byon pas/ der slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang mjal te/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zab pa zhig zhu byas pas/ skad cig gis slob dpon rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs brgyad bgrad pa/ rngams shing 'jigs pa gcig tu gyur nas drag po'i rta skad thengs gsum bton pas ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'dus nas rta mgrin 'di'i dbang bskur ro// de nas pad+ma rgyal po'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ ngas rta mgrin gyi rgyud brgya dang brgyad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las btus pa'i gsang sgrub gcig byas nas snye mor gter du sbas yod pa de sngags pa las can cig gis gter nas thon yod pa der zhus shig

rgyal po dang pe dkar dkor 'dre 'gong po'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ lha srin sde brgyad 'joms par byed do// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i sang nyin gser srang gang dang dar yug gcig 'bri gnyis bsnams nas snye mor byon/ slob dpon sngags pa la phul nas gsang sgrub gsan no// de nas yang mnal lam bzung nas slob dpon pad+ma la zhus/ sgrub thabs 'di lan gsum gyi bar gsungs nas da dung 'khor lo ma byin par 'dug pas zhus shig gsungs nas/ yang nyi khri dang*/ bur tong dang*/ dol snam gnyis khyer nas zhus pas 'khor lo'i gdams pa gnang ngo*// de nas sgrubs pas myur du zhal gzigs nas/ rgyal nad dang smyo 'bog can brgya lhag tsam btul/ 'di'i bskyed rim la brtan pa thob na'ang*/ snang ba bden med du ma rtogs par gdon drag po dang smyo ba btul na grib dang 'gras chen po yong bar 'dug pas/ btub tshad kyis mi bya gsung ngo*// yang ngas gdung rten rgyal po can zhig la rab gnas byas pas rgyal po de 'gro ma 'dod nas rten de la rdo rje bsnun pa'i stangs stabs drag pos gcun pas/ rta mgrin gyi phyag gi rdo rje las me 'bar bas kho bred dngangs nas phyi'i rgya mtsho la bros song bas/ rab gnas legs kyang phyis nga la 'gras pa'i le lan du ma tsam byed du byung bas/ sbyin sreg byas nas rgyal po 'di gtan nas rlag par byed dgos 'dug snyam tsa na de nub rmi lam du slob dpon pad+ma byon nas/ dbon ston khyed yi dam la brtan pa thob 'dug ste/ gdon chen po ma rdungs/ nyams pa chen po ma skongs/ klu chen po la sbyin sreg ma byed/ sngags pa la ma gshe/ mched grogs la zol 'grogs mabyed/ sems can la blos spang mi bya/ chig brgyud las spel du mi rung*/ de bas na snod ldan gyi slob ma la chig brgyud kyi bka' rgya gnang*/ skyer sgang pas gnyan ston la gnang*/ des sangs rgyas ston pa la/ des mkhas grub shangs ston pa la'o//

༈ /rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rje tshar chen gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ha ya grī wa na mo/ shangs lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ljang gu/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra khams ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu gsum gyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu gsum kha gdangs shing rta skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas stong gsum gang ba/ phyag drug g.yas dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri /g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung thung*/ gsum pa na rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ glang chen gyi ko glon dang*/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ mi'i skra yi tshangs skud dang*/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa bzhi bskums zhing*/ g.yon pa bzhi brkyangs pas klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par brdzis pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rta mgrin tshon gang pa res go mtshams med par gtams pa/ rang dang de thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ltar sgrogs shing*/ me phung 'bar bas gdon bgegs thams cad gzhob thul thul du bsregs par bsams la/

oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya stong la sogs pa bzla'o// zlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥtrig nan dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya bh+yoḥ sa ma ya zlog sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbud/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa'i drag sngags 'di yang nyer gcig tsam re bzlas pa'i mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces brjod do// dpal rta mgrin shangs lugs kyi mngon rtogs tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'o// ༈ /dpal rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'dir dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud las 'ongs pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs bya ba la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ 'di nyid kyi bris sku la sogs pa yod na dgram/ de'i mdun du lcog rtse la sogs pa'i stegs bu'i khar/ maṇ+ḍal ras la sogs pa la chu tshon gyis bris pa'am/ rdul tshon gyis bris kyang rung bas chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis rim rtse mo rang la bstan pa'i mthar me ri kha dog sna tshogs sam ljang gu gang rung gis bri/ de'i mthar khyams gru bzhi nyis rim du bris pa'i nang*/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ phyi'i re khā nyis rim gyi bar sngon por bya'o// maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du dpal gtor sum cha zlum po/ sum gnyis gru gsum dpal dang bcas pa mtha' mtheb kyus bskor ba/ 'bri mog gis kha dog dmar por bsgyur ba la mda' dar dmar po btsugs/

spros pa la dga' na bla ma kha cig gi phyag len la gtor ma'i rtser rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma dmar por yod pa zan la bcos pa 'dzugs par mdzad pas de ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// de'i mdun du bla ma/ yi dam/ chos skyong*/ gzhi bdag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba gsum mam bzhi bsham/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga mdun nam/ mtha' skor du bsham/ bgegs gtor cog zlum zhig kyang zur du bzhag tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ me tog la sogs pa'i nye bar mkho ba thams cad ma tshang ba med pa bsag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dkyus bzhin byas la/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gtor ma dang bcas pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dpal rta mgrin dam tshig par bskyed/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ mchod bstod/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba rnams bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ las kyi rdo rjes bgegs gtor la chab btang*/ slob dpon gyis/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs sam/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bgegs la gtor ma byin/ rang rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas me mtshon khro bo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par 'phros/ bgegs thams cad nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bskrad cing tshar bcad par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur ba zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs mi min mi ru rdzu ba/ lha min lha ru rdzu ba/ gsang sngags zab mo nyan pa la mi dbang ba de dag thams cad sa phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rgyang ring du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad me mtshon khro bo'i tshogs 'di rnams kyis skad cig nyid la thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o// oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta sogs drag sngags rnams brjod cing*/ nyungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing rol mo'i sgra drag po bya'o// de nas las kyi rdo rjes maṇ+ḍal gyi me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon yi dam gyi nga rgyal drag po dang ldan pas/ slob ma rnams la 'di skad gdams par bya ste/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ khyad par du yang lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad bde blag tu bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub bam/ shangs lugs sam/ zhabs brgyad par grags pa 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba'am/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa zab mo zhus la nyams su blang snyam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par mdzod/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad theg pa rim pa dgu'i chos su 'dus pa las 'dir bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i chos skor/ de la'ang sgrub sde chen po brgyad yod pa las pad+ma gsung gi chos skor/ de la'ang rta mchog rol pa dang*/ pad+ma dbang chen/ bde gshegs 'dus pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ bdud rtsi thigs pa la sogs pa mang du yod pa las rta mchog rol pa'i skor/ de la phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/

gsang sgrub gsum las/ 'dir shin tu byin rlabs che ba'i gsang sgrub zab mo 'di nyid kyi byung tshul lo rgyus la/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi chig brgyud rdo rje'i rgyas btab pa'i brgyud pa rin chen bdun du grags pa'i nang tshan brgyud pa lnga pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul/ grub thob chen po dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge de nyid kyis thugs dam 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang nas dag pa'i zhing khams du ma gzigs/ sangs rgyas byang sems mang po las chos gsan/ khyad par shing pho rta'i lo dgun zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi tho rangs mnal lam bzung nas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du byon pas/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang mjal nas/ deng sang bod yul na chos sgrub pa la spyir lha srin sde brgyad/ khyad par rgyal gdon 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyi bar chad che bar yod pas/ de dag gi gnyen por gyur pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zab pa zhig zhu byas pas/ slob dpon skad cig de nyid la rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhig tu gyur nas rta skad thengs gsum bton pas snang srid kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'dus nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa tshul bzhin byas/ dus de nyid du slob dpon pad+mas dbon ston skyer sgang pa la rta mgrin 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba gnang ngo*// de'i tshe slob dpon gyi zhal nas ngas rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las btus pa'i gsang sgrub zab mo zhig snye mor gter du sbas pa sngags pa zhig gis gter nas thon yod pas der zhus shig rgyal po pe dkar dkor 'dre 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang lha ma srin sde brgyad thams cad 'joms par byed do// zhes lung bstan pas/ snye mor byon nas slob dpon sngags pa rgya gangs ri ba zhes bya ba la/

rta mgrin gsang sgrub 'di nyid zhus so// de nas yang mnal lam bzung nas slob dpon pad+ma la zhus pas lan gsum gyi bar du da rung 'khor lo ma byin par 'dug pas zhus shig gsungs pas/ yang nyi khri dang*/ bur tong dang*/ dol snam gnyis phul nas zhus pas 'khor lo yang gnang*/ 'di nyid kyi grub pa thob cing 'gro phan rgya che bar byung bas rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs zhes phyogs thams cad du grags par gyur/ de la gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis 'di nyid zhus nas bsgrubs pas/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig nas zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing lung bstan thob/ dkar chung rgyal po la sogs pa dkor bdag 'khrugs te gnod pa'i smyon pa brgyad cu tsam btul/ gzhan yang lha srin gdug pa can mang po dam la btags/ de la sangs rgyas ston pas zhus nas bsgrubs pas zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ 'byung po mang po btul zhing dam la btags/ khyad par 'di'i sgo nas dkar chung rgyal po btul bas rgyal po de nyid spre'u'i pags pa'i gos dang stag gi sham thabs gon/ bya pho gcig khrid nas phyag zhung zhung 'bul zhing bdag rjes su bzung 'tshal zer ba dus de nyid du dam la btags/ de'i nangs par sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyi gsung nas mdang dkar chung rgyal po de ltar byed pa de kho gting nas mos shing thul ba yin gsungs/ de ltar tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ sa gsum gyi bdud thams cad 'dul ba'i dbang thams cad thob par gyur cig ces brjod la me tog gtor/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi cho gas rta mchog rol pa'i skur gyur pa mchod yul du bzung ste mngal dbul gyi tshul du mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pas kyang mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs/ shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog

/sesam can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang skur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ de dag ni lha sgom pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// gsung bzlas pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i sngags phreng la thim/ de las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus te thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa dang bcas lha'i nga rgyal brtan po'i ngang nas 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ gong gi sngags rnams lan gsum re rjes zlos byar gzhug gyin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te spyi bor bzhag pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mchog rol pa yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal rta mchog rol pa yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas rang dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs chad de rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/

snying ga'i hūm̐ yig la thim pa'i rkyen gyis 'khor rnams gtso ba la thim/ de'ang rim gyis 'od du zhu nas snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ de'ang zhabasakyu khog pa/ khog pa mgo bo/ mgo bo zla tshes/ zla tshes thig le/ thig le nā da la thim/ de'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de las slar rta mchog rol pa'i skur lam gyis ldang mdzod/ de'i mtha' rten du phrin las gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba ni/ gtor ma mgor bzhag la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ky-i// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung 'gyur ba'i// gtor ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya// badz+ra kro dha la a bhi ṣiñca btags pa brjod/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba spyi bo'i gtsug tu thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas srung ba'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor hūm̐ yig bkod pa la de 'dra ba du ma byung ste sku lus kyi stod smad thams cad rdo rje'i go chas zhu lugs su gtams pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mdzub mo g.yas su trūm̐ las khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyis mche ba dang sdigs mdzub/ g.yon du oṃ las khro bo mi 'chi thab sbyor dmar po rgya gram dang sdigs mdzub can du bskyed la/ oṃ trūm̐/ zhes lte ba/ snying ga ltag pa/ dpral ba/ spyi bo rnams su rim par mdzub mo gnyis bsnol ba reg gnas de dang der khro bo gnyis po zung re zhabs bsnol nas zhal phyir gzigs te srung ba'i las mdzad pa'i thugs ka nas rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud byung bas bsrungs shing brtan par bsam mo// des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ mjug dam tshig khas blang ba sogs spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams rim gyis brgyud nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par byon pa'i yi dam khyad par can 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba'am/ byin gyi rlabs pa zab mo sgrub par byed pa la/

slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin nas/ slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa thog mar yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i slad du/ da ltar gyi slob dpon 'di nyid dpal rta mchog rol par gsal ba la de nyid kyi byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren mdzad lha// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// rdo rje bla ma mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rta mgrin la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum brjod/ byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba ni/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gtor ma dang bcas pa dbyer med pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar nag phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me phung kha dog sna lnga 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma klu brgyad bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin ces sogs mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ mtha' skor kun du yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon du bzhugs par bsam/ bla ma dang yi dam ngo bo tha mi dad pa la rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul pas mchod par bsams la/

bla ma rin po che bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ sku yi byin rlabs lus la gzhug tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon rta mgrin du gsal ba dang*/ mdun gyi rta mgrin gnyis char gyi dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab par byung ba'i sna la rta mgrin dkar po 'jigs shing rngams pa sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa byung nas/ khyed rang rnam pa'i spyi bo nas thogs med du zhugs shing thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad khengs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhal du dmar cham cham gsol/ sku lus kyi me phung gis gzhob thul thul bsregs/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis gtubs/ rdo rje'i gar mdzad sngags kyi sgra bsgrags pas lus sems la bde chen gyi ye shes skyes/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i mos pa gyis zhes brda sprad la/ slob dpon gyis oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta sogs sngags kyi mthar/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dus da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig mthun rkyen legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs shig ces pa'i mthar sngags rnams drag tu brjod cing*/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug ḍā dril gyis sna drangs pa'i rol mo'i sgra chen po bya'o// de bzhin du gsang ba'i dbang dang*/

gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhes pa'i gsol ba gdab/ mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po'i sna la rta mgrin dmar po byung*/ mgrin pa nas zhugs gsung gi byin rlabs dang gsang ba'i dbang thob par mos la sngags rol bya'o// yang mchod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhes gsol ba gdab/ thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing ga'i sna la rta mgrin mthing ga byung*/ snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsams la sngags rol bya/ yang mchod/ dbang bzhi pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs lus ngag yid gsum la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ lte ba nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi sna la rta mgrin dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ lte bar thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob par mos la sngags rol bya'o// lha dngos kyi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal steng gi gtor ma slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la gtor ma de nyid dpal rta mgrin dngos su gsal ba'i steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa g.yon na dpa' mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sku dges pa'i gar mdzad/ gsung sngags kyi sgra sgrog thugs bde gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas khyed rang rnams la brtse ba chen pos dgongs shing byin gyis rlob bzhin pa 'ur 'ur chem chem bzhugs pas khyed rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad zhal du dmar cham cham gsol pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ sngags rnams kyi mthar/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dbon ston skyer sgang ba chos kyi seng ge/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/

mkhas grub shangs ston chen po/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa'i mtshan can/ drin chen sangs rgyas rnam rgyal la sogs pa phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma zhes pa nas/ 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs shig ces pa'i mthar bye brag tu yang rdo rje slob ma 'di dag la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ bar gdon bdud btsan ma mo rgyal 'gong the'u rang 'byung po'i gnod pa thams cad dus da lta nyid du zhi ba dang tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing*/ spos rol byas pas mdun gyi mtha' skor gyi lha tshogs rnams rta mgrin la thim/ de nyid slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim pas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres nas slob ma rta mgrin dngos su gyur par bsams la/ de'i nga rgyal la ji tsam gnas kyi bar du 'dzin med du mnyam par bzhag go /sngags bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ mdun gyi rta mgrin dang slob ma rta mgrin du gsal ba gnyis char gyi thugs kar hūm̐ dmar po'i rtse mor hrīḥdamar po re re bsam/ rta mgrin gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po sngags kyi sgra sgrog cing me 'bar bzhin pa bsams la/ slob mas slob dpon la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon gyis yi dam la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/

mdun gyi rta mgrin gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng rnams las sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi rnam par byung*/ zhal nas thon/ slob ma rta mgrin du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi sa bon gyi mtha' g.yas skor du 'khod par bsams la/ lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byas pas dang po dam tshig pa/ gnyis pa ye shes pa/ gsum pas brtan cing rgyas gdab pa'i tshul du bsams la/ slob dpon gyi phreng ba la 'jus te/ rtsa sngags/ khams gsum dbang sdud kyi sngags/ las sbyor gyi sngags rnams bzlas pa'i mthar/ slob dpon gyis phreng ba'am me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyi thugs rje nus pa/ sngags kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ des khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub skyer sgang lugs zhes bya ba 'di'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che ba mdzod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs 'khor yod na tshul bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'am/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// de ltar dpal rta mgrin gsang sgrub skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba 'di ni las dang po pa'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i cha rkyen bklags chog gi tshul du lam 'di'i rig pa 'dzin pa blo gsal gyis rang gi bsti gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// ༈ /rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ha ya grī bā ya/ tshe rta zung 'brel byed na/

tshe bum tshe chang sogs kyi g.yas g.yon gang bder gtor ma dmar po snying gzugs rgyan ldan dang*/ tshom bu smug rtsis kha bsgyur ba'am ma bsgyur kyang rung bas gcig bsham/ tshe dbang dang 'brel tshe mchod pa thun mong du gcig pu des chog 'di rkyang pa zur du byed na mchod pa zur du bsham dgos/ sngon du sgrub pa'i tshul ni tshe dbang bsgrubs tshar ba'i rjes sam/ gnas skabs gzhan du yang rung bas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba/ phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me phung kha dog lnga ldan du 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dkar po/ zhal gsum gyi steng nas rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas dmyal ba yan chad me yi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bres khebs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung*/ gsum pa na rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams kyang khro chung tshon gang bas gtams pa/ zhal gdangs zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ zhal gsum ka'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa/ zhabs brgyad klu brgyad kyi steng na bgrad cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khro bo'i rgyal po spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la gnyis su med par thim/

lha'i nga rgyal gyi ngang nas/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥdamar po zhes pa tsam las gzhan mi dgos/ mdun gyi gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta sogs kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+ṇa sa ma ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas khro bo'i sku// chos sku 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod// khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag dang slob ma rnams kyi nad gdon bgegs rnams zhi zhing tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i tshul ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rta mchog rol pa'i rjes su gnang ba gsan snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang gsan pa'i chos ni dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud la brgyud pa rin po che sna bdun du grags pa las/ brgyud pa lnga pa dbon ston skyer sgang pa de nyid mnal lam 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang las dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams du ma bgrod de/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa la chos gsan par mdzad/ khyad par shing pho rta'i lo dgun zla ra ba'i yar tshes bcu bdun gyi tho rangs mnal lam bzung nas/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang du byon/

slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas dang zhal mjal te/ deng sang bod na chos byed pa la spyir lha srin sde brgyad dang*/ khyad par rgyal 'gong gi gnod 'tshe che bar 'dug pas/ de'i gnyen por rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs khyad par can zhig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon chen po rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhig tu gyur nas/ rta skad thengs gsum bton pas snang srid kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro la sogs pa der 'dus/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin du byas nas/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa la rta mgrin gyi dbang bskur bar mdzad/ 'di skor gyi gdams pa rnams snye mo nas sngags pa zhig gis gter nas spyan drangs yod pas de la zhus shig gsungs/ mnal sad pa dang rim gyis sngags pa de la gdams pa rnams kyang zhus/ 'di'i sgo nas 'gro don shin tu che bar byung bas rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs zhes phyogs kun tu grags pa byung*/ des brgyud pa drug pa gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gnang*/ des zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsgrubs pas zhal mngon sum gzigs/ dbus kyi dkar chung rgyal po la sogs pas gnod pa'i skye bo brgyad cu tsam yang 'di'i sgo nas btul/ rgyal po glags lta ru byung ba la byams snying rje tshad med du bsgoms pas/ khos gus pa'i sgo nas phyag zhum zhum du 'tshal/ de phyin chad khong la zhe nas mos shing gting nas thul ba yin gsungs/ des 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la gnang*/ de nas bzung bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud de byon pa yin pas yid ches kyi gnas su mdzad 'tshal/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa 'bul ba la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ slob ma la bya ba'i ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon khro rgyal rta mchog rol par gsal ba la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren mdzad lha// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// rdo rje'i bla ma mdzad du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ spro na rgyun bshags kyang lan gsum/ rjes gnang gi gzhi lus sgrub pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon rta mchog rol par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po tsha zhing sreg pa bzod par dka' ba bun gyis 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog pas sku tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon bgegs dang sdig sgrib rnams bsregs shing sbyangs nas dag par byas/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas/ zhes pa nas/ gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ de rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dang*/ lha dngos kyi byin rlabs gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po'i slad du thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon la rta mchog rol pa dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon rta mchog rol par gsal ba'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po skya bun 'phros pa'i sna la rta mgrin dkar po sku chung la yan lag rags pa me phung 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhal du dmar 'jir gsol/ sku lus kyi me phung gi 'od kyis gzhob thul bsregs/ ro ma rnams kyang mtshon cha sna tshogs pas gtubs/ sku sgeg pa'i gar mdzad/ gsung sngags kyi sgra bsgrags pas lus sems kyi steng du bde chen gyi ye shes skyes/

bum dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta sogs brjod cing rol mo chen po'am/ dril gsil bya/ de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la rta mgrin dmar po sogs sngar bzhin rigs 'gre zhing*/ sngags brjod dril gsil bya/ 'di la ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i zhes dang*/ gsang dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ de bzhin du thugs la'ang yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i zhes dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ lte ba nas 'od zer mthing ga 'phros pa'i sna la rta mgrin sku chung la zhes pa nas/ sngags dang dril gsil gyi bar rigs 'gre/ 'di la yang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas zhes dang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las bcas pa'i byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs/ zhes 'don pa cung zad bsgyur/ gnyis pa lha dngos kyi byin rlabs ni/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta sogs tshar gcig brjod la/ gtor ma 'di skad cig gis dpal rta mchog rol par gsal ba'i steng gi nam mkhar slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas su dpa' bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ g.yon du dpa' mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs kyis bskor ba khyed rang rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs te 'ur 'ur chem chem bzhugs pas gnod byed kyi nad gdon bgegs rigs sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams zhal du dmar 'jir gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥ trig nan hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya zlog sa ma ya bh+yoḥ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbud/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ

slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ pha rgod thar pa dpal bzang*/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ rin chen sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rgyud la byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ khyad par du khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs/ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bsrung ba dang*/ bskyabs pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ dngos grub stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag bar gdon btsan dang dmu/ rgyal 'gong the'u rang*/ ro langs 'byung po'i gnod pa rnams nye bar zhi zhing tshar bcad par mdzad du gsol/ steng gi bla ma rnams dang mtha' skor gyi lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas rta mchog rol pa la thim/ rta mchog rol pa 'od dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du mar zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la thim pas khro rgyal rta mchog rol par dngos su gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ rjes gtso bos sogs spyi dang mthun/ slar mdun bskyed la mchod bstod yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod par gsol/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba bsngo/ smon lam gdab/ bkra shis kyis mtha' brten par bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni rje bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel gyi bka' 'bangs dge slong ngag dbang chos grags kyis bla ma'i gsung las ji ltar byon pa rang gi slob brgyud la gnas pa rnams kyi ched du/

dpal rtse gdong phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwa chen por legs par bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan cing 'tsho gzhes par gyur cig gong gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ zhes pa'i mtshams/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ zhes sogs sbrel lo// yang na/ ngag dbang chos grags nas/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mtshungs med dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros man 'dra'o// gzhan yang brgyud pa'i khyad par mang du yod pa rnams gang mos sbyar chog pas gsan yig rnams las shes par bya'o// ༈ /skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo ba ra ha ya la li tā ya/ khyod zhal mthong ba'i mod la bdud sde'i dmag stabs gcig lag cha 'chor ba'i khro bo'i rgyal// rta mchog rol pa nye bar bsnyen pa'i sgra// phyogs bral rna ba'i bcud du ches cher dngar// 'on te rgya gar mkhas pa pad 'byung dang*// bod yul grub brnyes skyer sgang dgongs pa'i gnad// ma rtogs rang bzor spyod pa'i chu 'dzin gyis// 'khrul med don gyi nyi 'od bsgribs pas nongs// snye mo gangs ri sangs rgyas dbang chen gyi// gter byon dam pa'i drin las legs thos pa// shog ser tsan+dan ngad dang bsang sngos dri// dbye ba'i dpyod ldan tshogs rnams dang du longs// de'ang o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha was rje 'bangs nyer lnga dpal sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad pa'i pad+ma gsung gi skor la rta mchog rol pa/

bde gshegs 'dus pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ pad+ma dbang chen/ bdud rtsi thigs pa sogs mang du yod pa rnams kyi nang nas shin tu zab pa rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub kyi skor ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su gdon bgegs 'byung po'i gnyen por zab gter du sbas pa snye mo rgya gangs ri ba sangs rgyas dbang chen gyis spyan drangs/ thang yig tu 'byung ba'i snye mo zhu yas gnod sbyin 'bar yang 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su bzhed pa yod cing*/ gang ltar zab gter gdan drangs pa dang dus mtshungs su dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chig brgyud rdo rje'i rgyas btab rin chen sna bdun du grags pa'i lnga pa dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen pos shing pho rta lo dgun zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi tho rangs mnal lam bzung nas slob dpon chen po'i drung du byon pa na/ sde brgyad spyi dang khyad par rgyal bsen gyi gnyen por gyur pa'i gdams pa zhus pa bzhin gnang ba dang gter ston la shog ser tshig brgyud kyang gsan pa'i bka' gter zung 'jug skyer sgang lugs su grags pa 'di nyid rgyal gdon la phan no zhes pa'i snyan grags kyis yid drangs te/ rma khar khyi tshil gyi dpe ltar sa dge jo zhal dwags shangs po lcags sogs grub mtha' thams cad la rlung ltar grags gshis yig cha'ang mang du 'dug pa phal cher gter gzhung ma gzigs pa'i gser ma'i mngon rtogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa mang zhing*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis gter gzhung la thugs gzhigs chug pa'i rnam dpyod che na'ang gnyis ka sa bon las bskyed pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i der ye shes pa spyan drangs pa dgug bstim mchod bstod byed par gsungs pa 'di nyid theg pa rim pa dgu las bskyed pa ma hā yo gar gtogs pas mi 'gal mod/ 'on kyang sngags rnying ma'i skabs su phyogs ma hā yo gar gtogs kyang nyams len a ti yo ga ltar byed pa du ma byung zhing rdzogs chen gyi dus sa bon las ma bskyed pa'i phyogs mang ba dang*/

spyan 'dren gyis mtshan pa yod med sna tshogs kyang ye shes pa gdod ma nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang du bgyis te/ spyan 'dren sogs kyi spros pa med pa du ma 'byung bas gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar lha nye bar bsnyen pa'i sgrub thabs ngag 'don du bya ba la/ thog mar skyabs 'gro ni/

gzhung du mi gsal yang don la dgos pa gzhir bcas shing sems bskyed bris chog mi 'dug pas gzhan nas bskangs/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// khyab bdag kun bzang go 'phang ma thob bar// dkon mchog 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba gsum// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi// lan gsum mam bdun sogs ji ltar rigs par bya/ sems bskyed ni/ mtha' med mar gyur drin chen 'gro ba kun// bla ma sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i ched// dbang chen rta mchog rol pa bsnyen pa'i thabs// zab mo'i sgrub pa nyams su blang bar bgyi// lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas la/ dngos gzhi ni/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo ka nas dag pa spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i rang bzhin lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i gdangs 'gag pa med pa thugs rje sprul pa'i sku chu las nya ldang ba lta bu'i tshul du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi rig pa bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa ltar dmar zhing 'tsher ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas zhal ljang gu/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ dbus zhal dmar po/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril zhing ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dang dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu re re'i steng na rta mgo ljang nag zhur dkar po phrum phrum ser po rngog ma dmar po kha gdangs shing rta skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas steng tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas 'og dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir thug gi bar me yi rwa gur gyis 'gengs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/

gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mi mgo sum brtsegs kyi steng rtse gsar ma'i rdo rje'i tshab tu rnying mar rtse gsum mdzad pa yin/ gsum gyis mtshan pa/ gsum pa na ral gri'i yu ba rang la bstan pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas mdung thung*/ gsum pa na rgyu ma'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ khrag gi thig le zhag gi sor ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus byugs pa/ mi skra'i tshangs skud dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bzhi bskums zhing g.yon bzhi brkyangs pas klu brgyad kyi ngo bo sbrul brgyad brdzis pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba/ rgod dang gshe dang snying rje rngam pa 'bar khro zhi ba sogs gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'i mgul gyi bum pa nas/ zhabs kyi long bu yan chad khro chung tshon gang ba sdang mig tu blta ba/ kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ bye phrug phyag sbug tu bcug pa ltar kha bas mig che ba'i khro chung gis gtams pa/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer thugs kar sa bon bshad pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i bzlas lung skabs dgos kyi 'dir zhal nas 'phros pas chog pa gter gzhung gi dgongs pa yin pa sngags 'khor gsal ma btab na lha de ngan par song dogs pa'i blo 'tshub langs mi dgos/ yar 'phros/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhing khams khyab/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sogs pa'i zag pa med pa'i mchod pas thugs rgyud mnyes/ byin rlabs rnams tshur bsdus bdag la thim pas sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad sbyangs/ yi dam gyi lha dngos dang khyad par med pa'i nus pa thob/ sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer mar 'phros/

mnar med sogs ngan song gsum dang bde 'gro'i sems can rnams la phog tsha grang btso sreg bkres skom glen lkugs 'gyur ba dang*/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs te bde ba la bkod/ ba spu nyag ma re'i rtsa ba na rta mgrin dpag tu med pa dang sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal 'gong dam sri sogs gnod byed sde brgyad 'byung po byad ma rbod gtong dang bcas par phog mgar gyi sol mal du rtswa sbur babs pa bzhin gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad rang srog rang gis bcad pa ltar skrag dngangs rengs brgyal te thal ba bun bun song*/ lhag ma rnams kyang stong gsum gyi 'jig rten du rang bsdod pa'i dbang med par brlag par bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥ la lar badz+ra byed pa dang 'ga' zhig tu hrīḥdang badz+ra gnyis ka med pa'i sna tshogs snang ba gter gzhung du 'byin 'jug gis sbas pa ma rtogs par yig nag thug phrad du bzhag pa'i log rtog gis nongs so/ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ bsnyen 'di la bsnyen tshad 'bru 'bum mam/ las rung tsam la sum 'bum yin gsungs/ pa song nas rtsa sngags gsham du dbang du sdud sngags/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥ trig nan dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya stāṃ/ las sngags/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya zlog sa ma ya bh+yoḥ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ rnams spel nas nyer gcig bzla/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas lhar langs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs bsngo smon shis brjod bya/ rgyun gyi nyams len la gtor ma 'bul mi dgos shing bsnyen pa la dgos pa'i gsal kha ma byung yang*/ dbang mchog tu spyan 'dren mchod bstod bshad pa'i shugs las don gyis thob pas bris 'bur gyi rten dang*/ sgrub gtor rta mgo can bkod pa'i mdun du rtsa ba gsum dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/

sman rag bsham/ bdag bskyed kyi sgrub thabs 'don pa'i dus mdun bskyed gsal 'debs pa'am de tsam blos ma lcogs na thun mtshams su/ mchod rdzas byin brlab pa ni/ 'di'ang spyan 'dren mchod 'bul rnams rang gzhung du mi gsal bar rat+na'i rta mgrin gsang 'dus nas blangs/ hrīḥdam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogasaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rnamasaḥ thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul gyis bzhes: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba lin+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: lan gsum re brjod/ mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams bdag bskyed ltar gsal gdab/ spyan drang pa ni/ hrīḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: bde chen dbang drag rol pa yi: bskal pa'i me phung 'bar klong nas: dbang gi rgyal po gshegs su gsol: oṃ ha ya grī ba e h+ye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ hrīḥ spros bral bde chen gzhal yas dam pa 'diraḥ rten dang gnyis med dang du bsgrub slad du: dregs pa 'joms shing srin po 'dul ba'i lha: rngams brjid 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ha ya grī wa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag ni/ a ti pu ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: a la la hoḥ nyer spyod spyir 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ dbang chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bdug spos me tog mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan mchod pa'i sprin: snang srid mchod par 'bul gyis zhes: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrīḥ dbang chen gsang ba'i lha tshogs la: dbang po sna lnga'i me tog dang : gsur chen bdug spos dri yis mchod: zhun chen snang gsal mar me dang : rdo rje dri chu'i byug pas mchod: bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas dang ཿ rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras mchod: dug gsum sku gsung thugs gsum dang :

dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod: ma hā pañca pū dza hoḥ sman gtor rak+ta 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: dug lnga gnas 'gyur ye shes sgrub pa'i rdzas: ro mchog yon tan kun dang ldan pa 'di: gsol zhing mchod do 'gro ba'i don du bzhes: sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ chos sku snang mtha' longs sku pad+ma dbang*// sprul sku pad 'byung gter ston gangs ri ba// chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston chen po la// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ chos rje ston pa gtsang ma shangs ston dang*// rgyal mtshan 'bum pa khyung po tshul khrims mgon// sangs rgyas seng ge sangs rgyas rdo rje la// rtsa brgyad stong= /sarba pañca= /thar pa dpal bzang sangs rgyas rnam rgyal rje// tshar chen kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse dbang rab zhabs// bka' 'gyur ba dang bsod nams mchod grub la// rtsa brgyad= /sarba= slar yang khyung po tshul khrims mgon po'i zhabs// thugs rje chos rgyal don yod rgyal mtshan dpal// kun dga' rgyal mtshan dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sder// rtsa brgyad= /sarba pañca= chos rje yon mchog bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal// gye re lha btsun dpal 'byor don grub rje// chos dbyings rang grol rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs// rtsa brgyad= /sarba pañca= /dbang drag khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i lha// ma dang mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong tshogs// gter gyi srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag la// rtsa brgyad= /sarba= hrīḥ phyi nang dam rdzas gsang ba'i gtor chen po: snang srid gzhir bzhengs 'dod yon ro mchog spungs: sha khrag dmar dang zhag gi sprin tu gtibs: dbang chen rta mchog zhal du rol zhing bzhes: ma hā ba lin+ta khā hiḥ gtor brlab rgyud sde 'og ma ltar dang 'bul sngags zur pa shangs pa'i yig rnying du snang ba gter gzhung gi dgongs par mngon/

hrīḥ dug gsum rtsad gcod dgra bgegs bsgral: 'khor 'das mnyam rdzogs bhan+dhar 'khyilaḥ dug lnga gnas su gzhom pa'i phyir: dbang chen rta mchog zhal du 'bul: ma hā rak+ta keṃ ni ri ti khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gdungaḥ chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos: spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas rngams chen sprul: rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo: dbang chen kun 'dus dbang gi rgyal po steḥ dbang gi mdog dmar bskal pa'i me 'dra la: dbang chen rngams brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: dbang mdzad dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje byams pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : las ngan gdug pa'i sems can sgrol mdzad pa: zhe sdang gtum khro dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rngams brjid 'gying ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: de nas gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngo/ tshogs bya ba 'dod na yang gsang dang gsang 'dus sogs nas blangs pas grub cing*/ tshogs phud dang po slob dpon pad+ma/ gnyis pa yi dam/ gsum pa chos skyong*/ bzhi pa gzhi bdag lnga pa gnod byed rnams la 'bul ba dmigs bsal du bshad/ mtshams 'grol khar dngos grub blang ba/ bshags pa rjes la brtan zhugs smon lam shis brjod bya'o// rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje snang mtha' yas// mi bzad bgegs dpung mthar byed rta mchog gi /gdams pa'i rin chen gling bgrod tshong phrug phal// log rtog 'ching bu'i khres kyis gcig tu ngal// o rgyan mkhan po'i bzhed gzhung bcu drug cha// yongs gang gzur gnas kun+da 'dzum pa'i tshe// 'gal dum spel ba'i yig nag chu nang gzugs// zla bar 'dzin rnams byis pa'i blo gros bzhin// de phyir nyams len khyer bde kun tshang ba'i// tshig gi srad bur brgyus pa'i pad rāg phreng*// shes ldan mgul pa'i rgyan du spud pa'i dges// bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal gyur cig /de'ang snga thog phyogs 'di la 'dris pa chung ngus drung yig ngag dbang dge legs dang sngags rams pa blo bzang don grub gnyis kyis bskul ma byung tshe/

brag sna chos rjes g.yas zhal dkar ba dang gshog pa yod pa sogs 'grigs 'grigs mang po gleng ba tshad mar bzung ba'i g.yar khral zhig bgyis pa dpyod ldan rnams khrel bdas kyi rgyu las ma mchis/ nye lam sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes pa 'di ni drung yig dar rgyas bkra shis kyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas bskul zhing*/ dge slong yon tan dpal bzang dang*/ sngags rams pa blo bzang chos ldan/ dgon pa blo bzang don ldan rnams kyis dgos tshul rim par byung ba dang*/ ging chen tshangs pa'i sku khog dbang 'dus rgyal pos gser srang gang sogs kyi skyes dang bcas bskul ba ltar dpyad shin tu bzod pa'i lugs su byas pa mon spa gro ba'i rdor gcod du 'gro shas che'ang theg dgu'i rnam gzhag mkhyen pa rnams kyis mi 'phya ba rgyu mtshan byas te yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las chos tshul 'di la blo mig yangs pa za hor gyi sngags btsun che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis me 'brug chu stod kyis nya ba bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen gyi nyin sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// ༈ /gong gi sman mchod kyi kha skong ni/ gye re lha btsun dpal 'byor don grub rje// zhes pa'i mtshams/ chos dbyings rang grol zil gnon bzhad pa la// rtsa brgyad= sarba= pad+ma phrin las rmor chen thams cad mkhyen// legs pa'i 'byung gnas kun dga' blo gros dang*// rdo rje 'chang dngos nam mkha' 'chi med zhabs// rigs kun khyab bdag 'jam dpal bzang po la// rtsa brgyad= sarba= zhes sam/ yang na kun blo'i rjes su/ bstan 'dzin phrin las phrin las yon tan zhabs// ngag gi dbang po bstan 'dzin snyan grags la// rtsa brgyad= sarba= dbang drag khro rgyal sogs sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge/ ༈ /rta mgrin gsang sgrub skyer sgang lugs kyi nyams len rgyun khyer bzhugs so// rta mgrin gsang sgrub nyams len byed par 'dod pas/

skyabs sems sngon tu 'gro bas/ skad cig gis bdag nyid dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar po/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dkar ba/ ral pa'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher zhing*/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas dmyal ba yan chad me'i rwa gur gyis khebs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung*/ gsum pa na rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ khro chung tshon gang ba kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pas sku lus gtams pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rnam pa brgyad sbrul brgyad kyi steng du bgrad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhugs par gyur/ bdag gi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pas bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rang la thim pas/ rang nyid yi dam lha'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ 'od zer me lce'i rang bzhin phar 'phros/ bar gcod gdon bgegs la phog pas rtsa sbur mes tshig pa bzhin gzhob thul gyis bsregs/ tshur 'dus mgul nas zhabs kyi long bu yan chad khro chung tshon gang bas go mtshams med par gtams/ rang nyid khro chung dang bcas pa'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug ldir ba ltar grags pas snang srid thams cad chem chem 'ur 'ur g.yos/ ye shes lnga'i me zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid las gsal zhing 'tsher ba tsha la rtsub pa phyogs bcur rab tu 'bar/ bar gcod gdon bgegs thams cad thal bar rlog cing 'khor 'das la dbang sgyur ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya stong khri 'bum bzla'o// skabs 'gar gong gi sham bur/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yo trig nan hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ

sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya zlog sa ma ya bh+yoḥ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ mthar mi dmigs par bzhag slar yang lhar lam gyis gsal gdab/ dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu gtor ma la zug nas bcud drangs shing gsol bar gyur/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa bhuñja hoḥ rak+ta pi ban+to sa ma ya swā hā/ lan lnga'am bdun gyis 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs rnam lngas mchod/ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gdung*// chos rje 'od dpag med las rdo rje chos// spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas rngams chen sprul// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang chen kun 'dus dbang gi rgyal po ste// dbang gi mdog dmar bskal pa'i me 'dra la// dbang chen rngams brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi gzis// dbang mdzad dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje byams pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// las ngan gdug pa'i sems can sgrol mdzad pa// zhe sdang gtum khro dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar// rngams brjid 'gying ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar gcod thams cad dang khyad par dkor bdag rgyal po'i gnod pa zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun gyi lha rang la thim par gyur/ bsngo smon bkra shis bya'o// 'di yang dge slong pad+ma phrin las kyis thub bstan rdo rje brag tu bris pa dza yan+tu//

༈ /rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen yig rab gsal me long bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ha ya grī wa maṇ+ḍal pā dā ya/ rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// rta mchog rgyal po'i gar gyis rnam rol te// sde brgyad dregs pa'i dpung tshogs zil gnon pa// bla ma yi dam dbyer med la phyag 'tshal// deng 'dir rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi// bsnyen sgrub ci ltar bya ba'i tshul// mdo tsam 'dri la bla ma lhas// gnang ba nyer stsol byin gyis rlobs// de la gsum/ sbyor dngos rjes so// dang po sbyor ba ni/ gnas dben par rta mgrin gyi bris 'bur byin can lta bu'i mdun tu stegs bu'i khar rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po me ri dang bcas pa phyi khams phyogs tshon gyi mthar re khā nyis rim gyi nang sngon por byas pa'i steng du mañci'i khar dpal gtor stod gru gsum la smad zlum po mtheb kyu'am pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba dmar po'i rtser rta mgo ljang gu me ris brgyan pa la tsakli gtor dar dmar po dang sha chen gyis brgyan pa/ de'i mdun nam g.yas g.yon tu bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma zlum po dmar po la mtheb kyu bzhis bskor ba gsum dang*/ spro na gzhi bdag la yang de 'dra ba gcig bshams pa dang*/ gnod byed la gtor ma ster bar gsungs pa ni bgegs gtor gyis 'thus/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka sgor mchod dam thad mchod gang rigs kyis mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ spro na tshogs 'khor sogs kyang bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rgyas par spro na/ kun mkhyen rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po lnga pa'i gsung sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng mdzes ltar ram/ las byang dbang chen dgyes pa'i rol gar gnyis gang rigs dang sbyar te nyams su blangs pas 'grub/ bdag bskyed kho na ltar nyams su len na rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sogs mi bya bar sman raka nyer spyod tsam la brten nas/

tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs sam kho bo'i nyams len rgyun khyer kho na thun bzhir bya zhing thun mthar rgyun khyer nang bzhin gtor 'bul bgyis pas 'thus/ gtor ma gsum po ni/ gter gzhung las/ rta mgrin la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs la 'bul/ gcig slob dpon pad+ma la 'bul/ gcig chos skyong la/ gcig gzhi bdag la/ gcig gnod byed la dbul/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rta mgrin gyi gtor bsngo dkyus ltar/ slob dpon pad+ma la 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gyis bsregs gtor bkrus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byis gyis brlabs la/ gu ru pad+ma i daṃ ba lin+ta khā hi zhes lan bdun nam lnga gsum gang rigs kyi phul ba'i mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi gsum gyis chos skyong spyir 'bul zhing ar+ghṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lin+ta khā hi lan gsum gyis gzhi bdag la bsngo/ gnod byed la cha gsum gyi tha mas bsngos kyang 'thus/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bar mdun bskyed spro na/ bdag bskyed bsgom dus me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bdag mdun gnyis ka tshig gcig gis gsal 'debs gyer sgom zhes pa snga 'gyur rang lugs yin pas de ltar bya/ yang na thun bzhi gang rung gcig gi mthar mchod rdzas brlab pa dang bdag bskyed ltar mdun bskyed tshig gis gsal btab la/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ phyi nang sman gtor rak+ta 'bul ba bstod pa sogs sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba ltar bya/ bsnyen dus kyi dmigs rim gter gzhung na gsal ba bzhin dang*/ de'i dgongs don sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng bar rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ bsdus don kho bos nyams len rgyun khyer du bris pa bzhin no// bsnyen tshad gzhung las nges pa zhig ma gsungs kyang spyi ltar bzhi 'bum mam 'bum phrag bcu'am/

yang na 'bru 'bum tsam thub na legs par sems la/ gtso bor rtsa bsnyen kho na dang*/ khams gsum dbang sdud dang las sbyor gyi sngags ni thun mthar ci rigs su bzlas pas 'grub bo// gter gzhung las/ tshogs dang gtor ma gzhi mthun 'dra zhig dang*/ gtor 'bul bshad rjes/ skong bshags dang bstod pa bya'o// tshogs la rol/ lhag gtor btang smon lam btab bsngo ba bya'o// zhes dang*/ sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng bar/ tshogs bya bar 'dod na/ yang gsang gsang 'dus sogs nas blangs pas 'grub/ ces gsungs pa rta mgrin yang gsang dang rat+na'i rta mgrin gsang 'dus gnyis la zhal 'phang gnang ba skabs dang 'brel zhing legs par snang yang*/ de gnyis ha cang rgyas shing khyad par pad+ma yang gsang la tshogs tha ma shin tu spros pa che bas mi 'grub pas/ med du mi rung pa'i tshogs kyi cho ga bsdus tsam zhig 'bri ba la/ tshogs kyi yo byad bshams te chab dang bdud rtsis bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ las me rlung chu byung bas// tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bkrus pa las// āḥlas thod par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i// rang bzhin 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥlan gsum gyis byin brlabs te/ gtor ma rnams la sman raka gis kyang bran la/ sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs rnams dang*// yi dam dbang chen ḍā ki chos skyong bcas// rtsa gsum lha rnams tshogs kyis skong gyur cig /gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ tshogs la rol rjes lhag ma'i gtor mar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ zhes phyir dor/ bdag mdun la mchod bstod bya zhing*/ bzod gsol yig brgyas chad lhag bskang*/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu lhar langs te bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/

sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba las/ mtshams grol khar dngos grub blang ba/ bshags pa/ rten la brtan bzhugs/ smon lam shis brjod bya'o gsungs pa'i don/ dngos grub kyi rdzas bza' bca' btung ba'i dngos po ci 'byor pa bsham/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba rang gi spyi mgrin snying ga lte bar gtugs pas/ sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dang byin rlabs thams cad thob par bsams la/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ zhes brjod/ mthar gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdud rtsir zhu bar bsams la/ dngos grub kyi phyir cung zad rol zhing*/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams kyang longs spyad/ gtor mgron dang mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ pad+ma satwa sbyar ba'i yig brgyas nyams chags bshags/ mdun bskyed dang gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa bris 'bur gyi rten la bstim zhing*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes me tog gtor/ dam tshig pa gshegs/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu bsngo smon shis brjod rnams gong ltar bya'o// de ltar rta mgrin gsang sgrub skyer sgang lugs// bsnyen sgrub yi ge rab gsal me long zhes// legs par bkod 'dis bdag sogs 'gro ba kun// pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob shog /de ltar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen pa'i yi ge rab gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di yang sbus sde lcang lo can pa'i sde pa chos mdzad kyi gsung gis bskul ngor/ dge slong bya bral pad+ma phrin las kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong sman mchog gis bgyis pa'i dge des 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal bar gyur cig/ ༈ /rta mgrin gsang sgrub la brten pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ye shes 'od 'bar bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ha ya a gra la li tā ya/ snang srid zil gnon gu ru pad+ma nyid// 'khor 'das dbang sgyur rta mchog rol pa'i skur// ston la phyag byas rta mgrin gsang sgrub la// brten pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg cho ga 'bri// de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/

dang po sbyor ba ni/ zhi ba la shis pa'i gza' skar dus sbyor bzang po la/ sa rjen dang ma dul ba'i rigs la sa'i cho ga spyi ltar bya/ yang thog dang sgrub khang rnying pa sogs la mi dgos shing*/ gang du bya ba'i sar stegs bu rgyar mda' gang gru bzhi dpangs su phyag gang ba'i lte ba mtho gang bskor ba'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po zur mdun bstan gyis dbus su lha mtshan rdo rje'am sa bon hrīḥdamar po'am yang na tshon spungs dmar po/ de'i phyir kha khyer sor bzhi dang*/ mu ran sor bzhi gnyis ka dkar ba/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ grwa bzhir mgo nang bstan gyi zla phyed rdo rje bri/ stegs bu gru bzhi'i steng thams cad rdul tshon dkar pos dgang*/ kha khyer gyi steng du nags kyi lci ba skam po srog chags med pas thab khung zlum po dpangs su khru phyed pa brtsigs pa la sa dkar lta bus kha dog bsgyur ba'i nang gi shar lhor me tshad zan gyi ting lo mar khus bkang ba bzhag 'o ma can gyi shing bu phra mos thab khung gi nang zing zing du bkang*/ rang dang me thab kyi bar du me yol la gangs ri dang chu rgyun wam̐ yig bris pa thab khung la bstan te bkod/ rang gi g.yas su bsreg rdzas shug pa'am/ ba lu lcang skya lta bu'i yam shing ma rul zhing gas chag med pa sor bcu gnyis sam brgyad pa rtsa rtser mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags pa dgos tshod dang*/ me srog 'dzin pa'i mar khu dang*/ bsreg rdzas zho zan/ til dkar ram til nag dūrba'am ma 'byor na ram pa/ 'bras so ba/ ku sha/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ sran ma rnams so so dang*/ spro na rta mgrin yang gsang gi gzhung las/ til dang me tog a mṛ ta// byi tang 'bras bu khu byug rtsa// ru rta shu dag rgya spos dang*// pri yaṅku dang lan tshwa dang*// pad+ma ge sar nā ga pus// zhes dang*/ mngar gsum bskus pa'i me tog dang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i rdzas rnams dang*/ gu gul dkar po/
tsan+dan dkar po/ dūrba/
