gu gul dkar po dang*/ 'di gnyis dpe la lar mi 'dug pri yang ku/ thang chu/ 'bras yos/ tsam pa ka'i me tog sogs bsres/ 'bras rtsam mam zhib chen la btab pa mar khu sogs kyis ril bur byas pa 'du bya zhing bsdu na ma byung yang 'thus/ gos dar dkar po'i na bza' sogs stan dkar po'i steng shel lam dngul lam kham phor dkar po lta bu'i nang du 'das ma 'das kyi dbye bas mang nyung gnyis su byas pa tshar du bkod/ rang gi g.yon phyogs su mchod stan dkar po'i steng*/ 'das ma 'das gnyis la phyi mchod lnga sbreng tshar gnyis/ de'i nang du me lhar dkar gtor zlum po dang*/ rta mgrin la sgrub gtor lta bu la rta mgo med pa dmar po'i g.yas su bdud rtsi dang*/ g.yon du rak+ta bkod/ mdun du cog rtse'am/ me yol gyi nang du rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba/ las bum/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ dpal 'bar mar la bsnyugs pa/ rlung g.yab/ mar khu la go yu dang stod ja btab pa'i so rtsi sogs bsham/ rang nyid gar chas sam thor tshugs dbu rgyan/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dkar po bgos shing bde ba'i stan la phyogs chen gyi shar du kha bltas te 'dug pa sogs sbyar ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rta mgrin gyi las byang rgyas bsdus gang rigs sam/ bsdu na mngon rtogs gnyis gang bde sngon du btang nas/ spro na rdor dril dgang blugs byin brlab sogs gzhan nas len/ ma byung yang chad pa'i skyon med/ bsang chu'i las bum bsgrub pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang du nyi ma'i dbus su āḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros 'og min nas bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus te bum chu la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsa bzla'o// de ltar bsgrubs pa'i bum chus thab khung bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas thams cad la g.yas skor du 'thor zhing*/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi yang 'thor tshul byed/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las nyi zla'i ga'u'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur bcangs pa'i gung mdzub gnyis rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya bsreg rdzas rnams la bstan te/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas rnams bkrus par bsam/ oṃ āḥswā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas rnams bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyang*/ āḥlas thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyer spyod bzang zhing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis gtor ma dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ lan gsum gyis rak+ta byin gyis brlab/ dpal 'bar g.yon gyis bzung la g.yas pas bsang chu gtor zhing bsang sbyang lag pa thal sbyar gyis bzung la rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ thab la lan gsum g.yas su bskor ba'i mthar me tshang ting lo sbar zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ thab khung bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po rgyar khru gang pa/ dpangs su khru phyed pa kha khyer dang bcas pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas ram̐ chad pa las 'od 'phros tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

me lha dmar ser ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas me dar dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sma ra ag tshom can tshangs skud 'chang ba/ sku las 'od zer 'phro ba/ spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros shar lho nas me lha 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che// me lha drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// ag+na ye de wa ṛ ṣi dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs pa rnams kyi bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ me gso ba'i phyir mar khu blugs gzar gsum blugs cing rlung g.yab kyis g.yo ba/ hūm̐/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /zhi ba'i don la dam tshig dgongs// gzi brjid che zhing thugs rje ldan// bdag cag gus pas khyod phyag 'tshal// oṃ ag+na ye de ba ṛ ṣi a ti pu ho/ pra tīts+tsha hoḥme lha'i nyer spyod kyi spos me sbar la/ hūm̐/ bdug spos snang gsal zhugs tog sgra// zhal zas dri chab gtsang ma 'di// me lha drang srong 'khor bcas la// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye de ba ṛ ṣi ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyi mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye de wa ṛ ṣi sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā ba lin+ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ lag g.yon gyis ku sha'i chun po brgyad bzung ba bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus ldan tu gyur/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge

/sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// 'di yis bdag la bgegs med cing*// las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes thab khung la ku sha rnams g.yas skor du phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtsa bas rtse mo non par dgram/ byon zan ni/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ dgang blugs kyi rtse la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ rdor dril dang bcas rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung ste mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang ba lag gnyis pus mo'i khongs las mi 'da' bar g.yas su bskor te/ oṃ ag+na ye di bya di bya bi shud+dha shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin na/ bdag cag ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dkyus ma la/ nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de ltar lan gsum 'bul/ hūm̐/ drang srong chen pos sngon chad ma bstar ba'i// ting 'dzin dbang sgyur zhal zas bdud rtsi 'di// dag cing gtsang mar bshams pa 'bul lags kyi// ye shes thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol// zhes brjod la bsreg rdzas kyi thog mar yam shing lag g.yon gyis bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te 'og nas bskor ba'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas 'bul zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye lha sngags/ badz+ra yā dz+nyā ya rdzas sngags la/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong sogs dmigs bsal dang spyir/ nad gdon sdig sgrib nas/ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes spel tshig btags te nyer gcig tsam 'bul/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes lha rdzas thun mong gi sngags dang*/ spel tshigs las sngags gong ltar du mar khu 'bul/ oṃ ag+ne lha sngags la rdzas sngags sarba saṃ pa de/ las sngags gong ltar zho zan 'bul/

de bzhin du sngags dang las sngags rigs 'gre zhing rdzas sngags/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hās til/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūrba/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭā ya swā hās 'bras kyi so ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā swā hās ku sha/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ya swā hās 'bras/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hās nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+rā ya swā hās na bza' rnams dang*/ spros pa'i yan lag tu rdzas ril 'bul na/ oṃ ag+na ye de wa ha bya ka bya di bya ba ha nā ya las sngags kyi spel tshig gong ltar ro// bsdu na ma phul yang 'thus/ gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i kha skong bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byed na 'og tu ye shes me lhar 'bul skabs til kho nar grangs gsog dgos shing*/ de bzhin du 'byor pa rgyas par 'dod na mar khu/ bde ba 'dod na zho zan/ tshe 'phel bar 'dod na dūrba/ nor dang 'bru 'dod na so ba/ srung ba la ku sha/ bsod nams rgyas par 'dod na 'bras/ shugs la nas/ rims zhi bar 'dod na gro/ stobs rgyas par 'dod na sran ma/ bzod pa phun tshogs pa la na bza' rnams 'bul lo// na bza' ma gtogs rdzas gzhan rnams yam shing gi grangs dang mnyam pa 'bul lo// oṃ ag+na ye de wi ra ṣi ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mtshan sngags mthar sman gtor rak+ta gong ltar 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// byon zan ltar mar khu dgang blugs kha sbyor lan gsum gong bzhin 'bul/ me lha 'od du zhu nas me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can tu gyur/ 'das lha mchod pa ni/ bdag bskyed rgyal dbang lnga pa'i gsung le tshan gnyis ltar ram/ 'dir spros pa bskyung na tshar chen rin po che dang kho bos byas pa'i mngon rtogs gang rigs ltar/

me 'bar ba'i dbus su rta mgrin bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren ni 'dir 'jug pa bde ba dang*/ o rgyan chen po rta mgrin gyi rnam par bzhengs pa yin pas skabs dang 'brel phyir/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// pad+ma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi// byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ gu ru badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rnga yab gling nas gu ru pad+ma rta mgrin gyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dam tshig par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan gyis bzhugs su gsol/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag pa yar lud pa las bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ bsdu na rigs bdag rang chas las dbang bskur gyi spros pa dor/ 'das lha'i nyer spyod kyi spos dang mar me sbar la/ hrīḥ bdug spos snang gsal zhugs tog sgra// zhal zas dri chab 'di rnams kyang*// pad+ma dbang chen lha tshogs la// mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ gu ru badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mtshan sngags la sman gtor rak+ta'i sngags btags pas de rnams 'bul/ byon zan ni/ ye shes me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las zhes sogs gong ltar la/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdun gyis mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis bkang ba'i dgang blugs kha sbyor lan gsum 'bul zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye di bya di bya sogs me lha'i skabs ltar ro// hūm̐/ ye shes klong yangs 'khyil pa'i hom khung du// rgyud lnga'i bag chags ma lus bsregs sbyangs nas// bdud rtsi sman dang gsang ba'i mchod pa sogs// dam rdzas gtor ma sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul// ye shes thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol// dam nyams dam skong mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// rdzas 'bul dus me lha'i mtshan sngags kyi tshab tu lha sngags gong ltar rta mgrin gyi rtsa sngags kyis mgo mnan te/

badz+ra yadz+nyā ya sogs yam shing dang*/ las sngags kyi spel tshig skabs dang sbyar te yam shing nas na bza'i bar 'jig rten me lha'i skabs ltar 'bul zhing*/ grangs ni stong ngam/ brgya rtsa lta bu skabs sbyar gyis 'bul/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong la til gsog dgos pa gong du bshad pa ltar ro// mthar byon zan ltar dgang blugs kha sbyor gsum gong ltar 'bul/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta gong ltar 'bul zhing gtor sngags skabs 'das gtor gyi cha shas thab nang du 'bul zhing*/ sman raka kyang 'thor/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba kun bdag chos sku pad+ma'i gdung*// zhes sogs gzhung ltar bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab rigs pas dpyad la skabs dang sbyar te gang 'dod kyi gsol ba gdab bo// oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hās so rtsi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ya swā hās gos zung 'bul/ oṃ pad+ma satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la sogs sbyar ba'i yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis chad lhag kha bskang*/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi mjug tu/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur/ thab kyi thal ba cung zad blangs te rang gi gnas gsum du byugs la/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu blugs gzar gang phul nas/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha sngar ltar bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye de wa ṛ ṣi ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta sngags kyis phul/ yam shing nas na bza'i bar bdun nam nyer gcig tsam phul rjes slar yang byon zan ltar mar khu dgang blugs kha sbyor gsum dang*/ nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta sngags kyis 'bul skabs 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i gtor ma'i cha shas thab tu 'bul zhing*/ sman rag 'thor ba sogs gong bzhin no// so rtsi dang gos zung yang 'bul/

me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// sogs kyis bstod/ sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di phul bas// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar dkyus ltar ro// ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis mdzad lags kyi// tshim zhing dgyes par mdzad nas kyang*// rang gnas bzang por gshegs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye de wa ṛ ṣi ya hi gats+tsha/ ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la gnyis su med par thim/ bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar bya'o// sbyin sreg sbrel mar byed na thal ba nan tsam byas pa'i steng lci bas thab khung brtsigs shing me tshang bca' ba sogs byas nas cho ga la 'jug gzhan du me shi ba dang thal ba phyag la chu klung du dor ro// de ltar rta mgrin gsang sgrub la brten pa'i// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ye shes 'od 'bar 'di// dge slong bya bral pad+ma phrin las kyis// bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /ces pa 'di yang sbus sde lcang lo can pa'i sde pa chos mdzad kyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten/ rta mgrin yang gsang dang snga 'gyur gyi gzhung bzhin/ sbyin sreg 'di lag len khog che bas zhib cha'i mthar dpyod rgyas bshad dgos kyang*/ 'dir rgyas bshad spros pa thams cad nye bar bsdus te med du mi rung ba'i lag len bde zhing shin tu gsal bar bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong sman mchog gis bgyis pa'i dge des 'gro kun ye shes kyi snang ba mchog tu rgyas par gyur cig/ ༈ /rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs grub gnyis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku pad 'byung gter ston gangs ri ba// chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston chen po la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// chos rje ston pa gtsang ma shangs ston dang*// rgyal mtshan 'bum dang khyung po tshul khrims mgon// sangs rgyas seng ge sangs rgyas rdo rje la// gsol ba=

/thar pa dpal bzang sangs rgyas rnam rgyal rje// tshar chen kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse dbang rab zhabs// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub la// gsol ba= /brgyud srol kun 'dus blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde// pad+ma 'phrin las rmor chen thams cad mkhyen// gnas gsar chos rje legs pa'i 'byung gnas la// gsol ba= /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos kun dga' blo gros dang*// bstan 'dzin phrin las phrin las yon tan zhabs// bstan 'dzin snyan grags rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ gsol ba= /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs dang*// rta mchog rol pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyis// phyi nang bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal nas// mchog thun dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge/ ༈ /rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub kyi rgyun khyer grub gnyis dpal ster ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ha ya grī bā ya/ rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub kyi rnal 'byor zab mo mdor bsdus te nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ skyabs sems ni/ bdag sogs 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar// rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi// gzhan don rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir// dbang chen rta mchog rol pa bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni/ 'od gsal stong nyid dbyings las rig pa'i rtsal// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng*// rang nyid skad cig rta mchog rol pa'i sku// dmar ljang dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa// dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang nag rta skad 'tsher// zhabs brgyad sbrul brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du bgrad// g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ral gri dang*// g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung thung rgyu zhags bsnams// gar dgu'i nyams ldan dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// ye shes me phung 'khrugs pa'i dbus na rol// mgul gyi bum pa nas bzung long bu yan// rang 'dra'i khro chung dpag tu med pas gtams// lha tshogs zhal nas sngags kyi sgra sgrogs shing*// 'od zer dpag g.yas mkha' khyab 'phros pa yis// 'phags mchod byin rlabs dngos grub rang la thim// 'gro kun sgrib sbyangs bde ba'i dpal la bkod// sde brgyad 'byung po byad ma brlag cing gzir// snang ba lha la grags pa sngags kyi sgra// dran rtog ka dag chos sku'i ngo bor gyur// oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces ci nus dang*/ sngon tu bsnyen pa song ba yin na/ sngags sham du dbang sdud kyi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥtrig nan dzaḥdzaḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dang*/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya zlog sa ma ya bh+yoḥ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa'ang sbrel la cung zad bzlas/ rgyal gdon la dmigs kyis bsal na/ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes sogs sa ma ya thams cad kyi mgor khaṃ rak+ṣa sbyar ba'ang bzla'o// thun mthar dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying pos sngags kyi lhag chad bskang zhing brtan par bya/ snang cha'i lha sku 'od gsal dbyings su thim// slar yang skad cig rta mchog rol par gyur// dge 'dis bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal nas// pad+ma gar dbang grub pa'i sa thob shog /ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod kyis mtshams sbyar te thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug gtor ma 'bul na/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rta mgrin la rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtshos bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu gtor ma la zug nas gsol bar bsams la/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa bhū ñja ho rak+ta pi pa ho/ sa ma ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gdung : chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos: spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas rngam chen sprul: rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes bstod/ rta mchog rol pa 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/

med na gshegs gsol sogs spyi ltar bya'o// bsnyen pa byed na/ ji skad bshad pa'i rnal 'byor thun bzhi'i rim pas rtsa sngags rab 'bru 'bum/ 'bring bzhi 'bum/ tha ma 'bum phrag gsum bzla ba dang*/ sngags gsum po sbrel ba'ang zhag gsum sogs ci rigs pa bzla/ phyi thun gyi 'jug tu gtor ma 'bul/ kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'am/ ma grub na yi ge brgya pa khri phrag sogs ci nus bzlas pas kyang rung ngo*// zhes pa'ang gter gzhung rtsa ba gsal byed dang bcas pa'i dgongs don ji lta bar bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos nyung gsal snying por dril te sbyar ba sid+dhi rastu// (༈ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris dge/)

༈ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi 'khor lo shin tu zab pa/ steng 'khor kher rkyang gi srung ba kha sbyar ba'i rang srung dang sri'u srung bar dbyug par btags nas brdung ba/ 'og 'khor liṅga bri nas mnan pa sogs rnam grangs mang yang rtsa ba gter byon yan pa tsam las bar skabs nas shangs pa sa dge sogs gsar ma ba'i nyams bzhes su song nas snga 'gyur la dar so chung gshis 'khor lo rnams kyang sku mtshams dam drag pas sna tshogs snang yang*/ 'dir gsal ba gter gzhung dgongs don ltar za hor smyon gyis bkod pa sngags rgan ral pa can tshos dpyad par zhu// ༈ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi 'khor lo 'di la/ steng 'khor kher rkyang la brten pa'i srung ba/ sngags mgo gtod phyogs bsgyur ba'i zlog pa/ gdon tshabs chen steng 'og kha sbyar nas rang dang sri'u gso ba/ bdag gzhan srung ba/ 'khor lo dbyug pa la btags nas 'dre rdung ba/ 'og 'khor gyi lte bar rgyal chen sogs gnod byed kyi liṅga bris te mnan/ sreg sogs 'og 'khor rkyang pa'i las sbyor/ au ḍī yā na'i ā tsār+ya de'i bzhed par za hor gyi sngags smyon gyis go ba tshad ldan yin min gsang chen rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyis dpyad par zhu/ bar skabs su gsar ma'i bla brang tshor sku mtshams la bzhugs nas dbu nyug nyug tsam yang mi 'dug go/ (༈ lcags zab lugs kyi rgyun la mo 'khor lugs 'di ltar 'dug kyang zur chen gyi phyag bris mar rtsibs mchan la rak+ṣa sa ma ya dzaḥtshar re dang*/ lte bar tri 'dug go/) (༈ lcags zam phyogs kyi rgyun la pho 'khor 'di ltar snang zhing zur chen gyi phyag bris la rtsibs mchan la bh+yoḥm gtogs gzhan mi snang ngo*//) ('dir 'khor lo khag bzhi 'dug pa bri ma thub/ ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
